theme.archetype: Archetype 5 (Luxury) mixed with Gen-Z cinematic neons
theme.rationale: Video-first content requires a dark backdrop to pop. The dark theme reduces eye strain, frames the full-bleed videos perfectly, and sets a 'night market/secret connection' emotional tone.

fonts.rationale: Distinctive, wide, playful, and slightly street-style. Perfectly captures the tongue-in-cheek 'Nice2Meechu' branding and breaks away from default tech fonts.
Highly legible in small sizes, neutral enough not to clash with the expressive headings, perfect for UI overlays on top of videos.

states_and_screens.Splash: Full bleed '#0A0A0C' background. 'Nice2Meechu' in Unbounded font, dead center, pulsing with a subtle neon drop shadow.
states_and_screens.PhoneEntry: Clean typography, large keypad area, minimalist text input. 'What's your number?' H2 heading.
states_and_screens.OTPEntry: 4-6 massive input boxes. Auto-focusing. Clean, high contrast.
states_and_screens.Onboarding: Step-by-step full-screen flow. 'Choose your codename' -> 'Select 3 Vibes (Pill tags)' -> 'Native Language'. Uses a progress bar at the top.
states_and_screens.Permissions: Bottom drawer/sheet rising over a blurred background. Friendly messaging: 'We need your camera to see your vibe, and location to find locals.'
states_and_screens.RecordIntro: Full camera view. Ghost outline for face placement. Large recording button at bottom with a red glowing ring. Max 10s timer.
states_and_screens.FeedSwipeCard: Full-bleed video taking the entire screen. Gradient overlay at top/bottom. Right side: Like/Pass floating action buttons. Bottom: Live translation overlay. Top left: Anonymity codename badge. Top right: Distance badge.
states_and_screens.MatchCelebration: Explosion of primary/accent colors. The blurred avatar slowly comes into focus, revealing the real handle. 'It's a Match!' text. Action to 'Chat Now'.
states_and_screens.Chat: Minimalist thread. Dark background. User bubbles in primary color, matched user bubbles in dark grey. Sticky header with their unblurred video playing silently in a small circle.
states_and_screens.Profile: Your own video intro playing in an infinite loop as the background. Glassmorphic cards overlaying to edit Vibes, Handle, Language.

motion_and_interactions.page_transitions: Slide up for new screens, fade for modals.
motion_and_interactions.swipe_feed: Vertical snap scrolling (like TikTok) using scroll-snap-y mandatory.
motion_and_interactions.translation_reveal: Typewriter effect or smooth fade-up for translated subtitles to simulate real-time AI processing.
motion_and_interactions.like_pass: Tinder/Hinge style micro-interactions. Heart icon scales up and pulses on Like. Screen shifts slightly.
motion_and_interactions.match_reveal: Blur value animates from 20px to 0px over 1.5 seconds with an easing curve, accompanied by a subtle scale-up.

background_gradients.description: Abstract blur for Match Screen Celebration

testing.data_testid_rules: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case and role-based. Examples: 'login-phone-input', 'otp-submit-button', 'feed-like-button', 'match-chat-button'.

instructions_to_main_agent: Ensure global layout is strictly mobile-first: max-w-md mx-auto with 100dvh.
Do NOT use default shadcn styles for the main video feed, build it bespoke using Tailwind absolute positioning and scroll snapping.
For the translation overlay, layer it elegantly over the video using the 'translation_overlay' specs. Ensure it reads clearly.
Hide real identities using CSS blur filters on images until the 'matched' state is true.
Use Phosphor Icons or Lucide-react for UI actions (Like, Pass, Settings, Chat).
Load Google Fonts 'Unbounded' and 'Manrope' in the main HTML/CSS.
Enforce data-testid attributes extensively as per the testing rules.
